title: Warm Spicy Kenyan Apple Tagine
description: This fermented Kenyan dish features apple juice and infuse-oil, making it a shojin-friendly option for adventurous eaters, with a unique glassy-jelly texture from the fermented apple juice.
instructions: Combine the fermented apple juice, infuse-oil, grated ginger, cinnamon, cayenne pepper, lemon juice, agave nectar, and salt in a large saucepan.
Bring the mixture to a boil over high heat, then reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and let it cool to room temperature.
Strain the mixture through a fine-mesh sieve into a large bowl, pressing on the solids to extract as much liquid as possible.
Discard the solids and let the liquid cool to room temperature.
Refrigerate the liquid for at least 2 hours to allow it to chill and thicken into a glassy-jelly texture.
Serve the Warm Spicy Kenyan Apple Tagine chilled, garnished with a sprinkle of cinnamon if desired.
